Tts._comment: Cloud text-to-speech. Set Provider to Google | Azure | Knowlez and supply credentials to enable native-quality Swahili audio. None = built-in browser/device voice. Prefer secrets via env vars (Tts__Knowlez__ApiKey) or user-secrets, not this file.

Speech._comment: Self-hosted Whisper speech-to-text for the pronunciation drill. Start whisper-service, then set Enabled=true (prefer user-secrets: dotnet user-secrets set Speech:Enabled true). Disabled by default so the app runs without it.
